repo_notes.content: Geogebra commands wrapped in custom components are found in folder: src/wrap-ggb/wrappings. Other Geogebra commands not implemented there can be accessed through the Cmd(command:str) command.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce PyGGB, its purpose as a Python IDE for GeoGebra geometry programming, and provide a high-level architectural summary

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: Explain the overall system architecture and how the major components fit together

pages.title: Module System and Python-GeoGebra Bridge
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the most critical system: how Python modules are registered, the API handover queue pattern, and how Python code connects to GeoGebra

pages.title: Python Execution Engine
pages.purpose: Explain how Skulpt compiles and executes Python code, the custom sleep() implementation, and error handling

pages.title: GeoGebra Integration
pages.purpose: Document how GeoGebra is embedded, initialized, and how the API is augmented for use by wrappers

pages.title: State Management
pages.purpose: Explain the Easy-Peasy store architecture, the main state slices (dependencies, editor, controls, modals), and how state flows through the application

pages.title: GeoGebra Object Wrapper System
pages.purpose: Overview of how TypeScript wrappers bridge Python objects to GeoGebra commands

pages.title: Wrapper Architecture and Shared Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Document the SkGgbObject interface, augmentedGgbApi, common properties system, and how wrappers are constructed

pages.title: Basic Geometric Objects
pages.purpose: Document Point, Circle, Line, and Segment wrappers with their constructor patterns and properties

pages.title: Complex Shapes and Curves
pages.purpose: Document Polygon, Ellipse, Parabola, Arc, and Vector wrappers

pages.title: Geometric Operations and Transformations
pages.purpose: Document Rotate, Intersect, Distance, Angle, and other operation wrappers

pages.title: Measurements, Predicates, and Special Points
pages.purpose: Document measurement functions (Area, Circumference), geometric predicates (AreCollinear, AreConcyclic), and special point constructions (Centroid, Incircle)

pages.title: Interactive Elements
pages.purpose: Document Slider and other UI-interactive wrappers, including event handling with when_moved()

pages.title: User Interface
pages.purpose: Overview of the React-based IDE interface and its major components

pages.title: IDE Layout and Components
pages.purpose: Document the main IDE component, layout system (CSS Grid), GeoGebra pane, and output displays

pages.title: Code Editor
pages.purpose: Document the Ace editor integration, resize handling, keyboard shortcuts, and read-only vs editable states

pages.title: Menu Bar and Execution Controls
pages.purpose: Document the menu bar, file operations, run/pause/stop buttons, and execution state machine

pages.title: Modal System
pages.purpose: Document the various modals (FileChooser, NewFile, Download, Share) and their state management

pages.title: Error Handling and Output Display
pages.purpose: Document ErrorList component, traceback processing, stdout pane, and how Python errors are displayed

pages.title: File Management and Persistence
pages.purpose: Explain how user files are stored, managed, and persisted using IndexedDB

pages.title: Database Layer (Dexie)
pages.purpose: Document the PyGgbDexie class, UserFile schema, and database operations

pages.title: File Operations and Auto-Save
pages.purpose: Document file CRUD operations, the auto-save mechanism with debouncing, and file naming system

pages.title: Share Links and Export
pages.purpose: Document how programs are shared via URL (with compression), and export functionality

pages.title: Testing Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Overview of the Cypress-based testing system and test coverage

pages.title: Python Programs Test Suite
pages.purpose: Document the 80+ test specifications for geometric operations, error handling, and object creation patterns

pages.title: Example Programs and File Management Tests
pages.purpose: Document testing of example programs and file CRUD operations

pages.title: Developer Guide
pages.purpose: Information for developers who want to contribute to or extend PyGGB

pages.title: Development Setup
pages.purpose: How to set up a local development environment, use local GeoGebra bundle, and run the development server

pages.title: Adding New GeoGebra Wrappers
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for creating new wrapper modules, registering them, and following wrapper patterns

pages.title: Build and Deployment
pages.purpose: Document the build process, deployment to GitHub Pages, and custom hosting options
